builds.name: Reference: Ranked bot core
builds.goal: Reference for Smolder: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ bot players use most (10,805 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 54.2% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A ranged spell-scaling carry who farms Q kills and ability hits into evolving damage patterns. He uses a short terrain-ignoring flight and an ultimate heal to preserve stacking time. The current adc provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Essence Reaver → Black Cleaver → Spear of Shojin. Deathfire Touch keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Gluttonous Greaves, Guardian Angel, Bloodthirster.
builds.summary: The proven bot baseline: Essence Reaver → Black Cleaver → Spear of Shojin, with Deathfire Touch.
testPlan: Play it in bot as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Essence Reaver → Black Cleaver → Spear of Shojin) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 54.2% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Essence Reaver → Black Cleaver → Spear of Shojin.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing [60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Slowing by [35]% for [1.5] seconds.

Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing [10 / 35 / 60 / 85 / 110 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.8) × AP] physical + @spell.SmolderP:Passive_WDamageIncrease@ magic damage.

Smolder belches flame, dealing [(60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 + (1.3) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1 + ((0.75) × Stat(8)) × ((-1 + (1) × Stat(9)))))] physical damage + @spell.SmolderP:Passive_QDamageIncrease@ magic damage. If the target dies, Smolder refunds [15] Mana, once per cast.

Based on stacks of Dragon Practice, this Ability evolves to gain the following effects:[25] Stacks: Damages all enemies surrounding the target.[125] Stacks: Sends [2 + (0.008) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})] explosions beyond the target that deal [50]% of this Ability's damage.[225] Stacks: Burns the target, dealing [(0.00025) × AD[statFormula=2] + (5e-05) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})] max Health true damage over [3] seconds. Enemy champions that drop below [(6.5) × (0.01)] total health while burning are killed instantly.

Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1) × AP] physical damage. Enemies in the center take [(150 / 250 / 350 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1) × AP) × (1.5)] physical damage instead and are Slowed by [40]% for [2] seconds.

Smolder's mom heals her son for [100 / 175 / 250 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.75) × AP] Health if she hits him.

Smolder takes flight, gaining [75]% Move Speed and ignoring terrain for [1.25] seconds.

While flying, Smolder bombards the lowest Health enemy [5 + (0.01) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})] (rounded down) times for [10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.3) × AD] physical damage + @spell.SmolderP:EBonusDamage@ magic damage per hit.

Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with {{Spell_SmolderQ_Name}} grants a stack of {{Spell_SmolderP_Name}}, which improves Smolder's basic Abilities.
{{Spell_SmolderQ_Name}}: Deal an additional [((0.25) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})) × ((1 + ((1.4) × Stat(8)) × ((-1 + (1) × Stat(9)))))] magic damage and gain new effects at @spell.SmolderQ:StackTier1@, @spell.SmolderQ:StackTier2@, and @spell.SmolderQ:StackTier3@ stacks.{{Spell_SmolderW_Name}}: Explosions deal an additional [(0.55) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})] magic damage.{{Spell_SmolderE_Name}}: Each hit deals an additional [((0.08) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})) × ((1 + ((0.75) × Stat(8)) × ((-1 + (1) × Stat(9)))))] magic damage and gain an extra bolt every [100] stacks.

Smolder has acquired Dragon Practice: @f1.0@.

builds.name: Hybrid sneeze caster
builds.summary: Test hybrid sneeze caster against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test hybrid sneeze caster against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Achooo's champion explosion has 0.8 AP physical damage and MMOOOMMMM has 1.0 AP physical damage plus AP healing; Gunblade retains AD for Q/E and Shojin supports basic spell casts. Earned Muramana adds physical spell damage, with Serylda supporting that physical emphasis.
testPlan: Required state: Land champion W explosions and R center while recording real Dragon Practice stacks.
Compare W/R damage and healing at equal earned stack counts.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Weak crit/Q progression and mana demand can lose sustained damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP scaling does not make those W/R components magic or accelerate stacks without real hits.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Gunblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Spear of Shojin, Serylda's Grudge, Muramana, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Critical duel
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Smolder: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A ranged spell-scaling carry who farms Q kills and ability hits into evolving damage patterns. He uses a short terrain-ignoring flight and an ultimate heal to preserve stacking time. Fix finite passive stacks and ability evolution. Current crit/AD/HP scaling and execute eligibility matter; an AP/burn experiment must justify losing the normal physical spell route. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
builds.summary: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Smolder: Fix finite passive stacks and ability evolution. Current crit/AD/HP scaling and execute eligibility matter; an AP/burn experiment must justify losing the normal physical spell route.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.

The route fails Smolder's stated kit question: Fix finite passive stacks and ability evolution. Current crit/AD/HP scaling and execute eligibility matter; an AP/burn experiment must justify losing the normal physical spell route.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.
Full cost 16,550 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Infinity Edge, Immortal Shieldbow, Lord Dominik's Regards are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Scorcher health caster
builds.summary: Test scorcher health caster against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test scorcher health caster against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Super Scorcher Breath has an explicit crit-linked physical multiplier and later a stack-gated true burn; Essence Reaver provides one physical Spellblade if Q's interaction is confirmed. Shojin and Bloodmail emphasize repeated spell damage with health, while Cleaver assists physical packets.
testPlan: Required state: Earn and record 25/125/225 stack thresholds through normal play.
Compare Q before and after each threshold, counting Spellblade separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Losing crit or reaching thresholds late ruins the damage plan.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: No free 225 stacks, and armor reduction cannot amplify the true burn or execute threshold.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
